definitions.explanation: Describes a striking degree of difference or improvement compared to before or to others. Emphasizes that the gap is significant and clearly noticeable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{格段|かくだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The skill level has improved remarkably.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{格段|かくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a remarkable difference compared to last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数年前|すうねんまえ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{格段|かくだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}している→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: Smartphone performance has improved dramatically compared to a few years ago.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in two main patterns:
- {格段|かくだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb/adjective: remarkably (adverbial)
- {格段|かくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: remarkable, exceptional (adjectival)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格段|かくだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: remarkably better
- {格段|かくだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧: to improve dramatically
- {格段|かくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: a remarkable difference
- {格段|かくだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧: remarkable progress

Typically used in positive contexts (improvement, progress) but can also describe negative differences.
